svg.text: OBJ-196 Planter, plant stand, disc base and two plates
Plates at x = 81 and 105 from the disc centre (offset); dashed = shelf Ø176.
REFERENCE PHOTO (third-party, maker unknown; second angle seen in session)
Plates read as offset; shape inferred.
The pot is not part of objekt.
FINISH: brushed stainless (objekt guide: exposed metal). No paint, no colourways. التشطيب: ستانلس مبروش بدون دهان.

All sizes are a PROPOSAL, not costed, Production to confirm. Disc Ø300, height 400 (photo proportion), pot hole Ø204 for the 4 L pot class (rim 200, base 155, height 165). المقاسات مقترحة ويؤكدها التصنيع.
